rows.Origin:
Bred by J.P. Agarwal (India, before 1983).
Introduced in India by Friends Rosery in 1983 as 'Kasturi Rangan'.
rows.Bloom: Mauve, yellow undertones. Moderate fragrance. Double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
